label: Napoleonic troop transport
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one production RTS Russian culture vessel sprite. STRICTLY TRUE 90-DEGREE DIRECTLY OVERHEAD ORTHOGRAPHIC VIEW. Bow points toward SCREEN BOTTOM, stern toward top. Entire ship and all oars/yards fit within square transparent canvas with at least 8 percent clear guard. Only deck surfaces and roofs are visible; no upright doors, hull side walls, front elevations or oblique perspective. Realistic hand-painted textured game art matching reference, clean readable silhouettes at 48/64/128px, restrained weathering, crisp dark edges, balanced overhead light. One vessel only, transparent alpha background, no water, wake, ground shadow, scene, labels, letters, flag fabric, people, side-view inset or UI. Subject: Large imperial Russian age-of-sail timber troop transport, three masts furled sails, spacious pale open decks, rows of open benches and low covered troop accommodation roof sections, no cargo heaps or broadside cannon. Emphasize organized passenger deck versus freight vessel. CAD PLAN camera. Three masts show ONLY small circular end-on tops, sails narrow horizontal furled rolls across deck. NO vertical mast shafts drawn in image plane, no walls, windows, domes or crosses. Transparent cutout with absolutely NO ambient ground shadow or backdrop.
Correction: Edit the reference overhead Napoleonic troop transport sprite. Remove ALL the rowing oars sticking out along its two sides. This is a large ocean sailing troop transport propelled by its three square-rig masts, not a galley. Preserve bench deck, pale accommodation roofs, furled sail yards and hull silhouette, add no cannons or cargo. Camera stays directly overhead, bow bottom. Transparent cutout only, no water, no wake, no surrounding shadow. Entire ship fits square canvas with clear margins.
conversion: Uniform alpha-bounds fit, Lanczos resampling and transparent padding only; original retained unchanged.
